snippet.title: E-Files - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Watch the trailer for E-Files, an upcoming psychological horror game in the style of the PS1 era, centered around a secret investigation, rituals, and the mysterious “Lists.” Explore dark locations, search for clues, solve puzzles, and avoid deadly traps. Fixed camera angles, retro graphics, and limited saves. E-Files will be available on PC on October 30, 2026.
